## Not guaranteed

Everything tagged "appearance, approximate" in the part, and every illustration choice. It is shown for looks only and is not checked against a catalogue dimension:

- The whole body shape: rails and blocks are the catalogue envelopes (WR x HR rail; W x L1 x (H - H1) steel block body with the rail channel cut out, end caps and seals to the length L); the roller tracks and the flange outline are not published as dimensions
- RGW mounting holes are tapped to the depth T (T and T1 are printed without a definition; the mounting code C means top or bottom, so the real holes may run through the flange), and the two rail-axis holes of both block types (legend 6-Mxl / 6-M) take the same thread depth as the flank holes
- The 10 mm gap between neighbouring blocks (illustration)
- Rail top chamfers and the two side roller tracks (circular approximations), block top chamfers, the end cap / end seal split of (L - L1) / 2 with its 0.5 mm inset and black plastic, and the brass grease nipple (appearance bodies and features named (appearance, approximate))
- Rail screws: SolidCraft's ISO 4762 standard part of the catalogue bolt size
- Materials and PBR looks of every body (ground top and raceway faces, satin body, plastics, brass, black oxide): SolidCraft appearance-library entries, black oxide with its own pbr
- Self-lubricant (E2) and reinforced cap (RC) options after + (parsed, not drawn), accuracy, preload and special E blocks / rails (recorded in the code only)
